title: Design System: JB'S Pro Painters, The Job Board

narrative.overview: The page is a charcoal drywall wall in a job trailer. Work is taped to it: white photo prints with marker captions, strips of blue painter's tape carrying the headline, the buttons and the service labels, and one yellow sticky note for the review. Depth comes from real, soft drop shadows under paper; the wall itself is flat charcoal with a faint noise grain. The mood is workmanlike and confident; blue tape is the only saturated color and the marker hand is reserved for things someone would write on a wall.
keyCharacteristics: Charcoal drywall ground, grain overlay, one saturated blue (tape) as the sole action color.
Torn-edge tape shapes for every primary action and label.
White prints, slight rotations, soft paper shadows.
Condensed all-caps display type at 0.9 line height; Barlow for everything readable.
Physical motion (spring drop-in, drag, 3D flip), removed under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Tape Rule
rules.body: Blue is tape. If something is blue it must look like a strip of tape (torn ends, stripe texture); no blue flat fills, outlines or links.

rules.name: The Paper Is Never Dark Rule
rules.body: Prints, form and note are light paper on the dark wall; text on paper uses #1d1e24 or darker greys, text on the wall uses the warm and lilac whites.

rules.name: The Hand Is Written Rule
rules.body: Marker type is for text that could plausibly be written on tape, a print or a note. Running copy, navigation and form text stay in Barlow.

rules.name: The Paper Casts, The Wall Doesn't Rule
rules.body: Only paper and tape objects carry shadows; no shadow on text, the wall, or the sound toggle and mobile bar.

dos: Do put every primary action and label on a torn tape strip in #2f6bd6.
Do keep text on paper dark (#1d1e24) and text on the wall warm white (#f3f0e8) or #c5c6d0.
Do keep display type uppercase at 0.9 line height and 0 tracking.
Do use the gold #ffd24a for focus rings.
Do disable hover and entrance motion under prefers-reduced-motion.
donts: Don't introduce another saturated color; yellow is paper only.
Don't use marker type for running copy or navigation.
Don't put shadows on the wall or on UI chrome.
Don't make photos or tape perfectly rectangular and axis-aligned.
